g.text: LRU read: a map entry identifies the exact list node
N_A, N_B and N_C are node identities. Moving a node does not create a replacement.
2. Detach N_A; keep its map entry
N_B.next = NULL; tail = N_B; N_A.prev = N_A.next = NULL.
3. Prepend the SAME N_A before N_C
N_A.next = N_C; N_C.prev = N_A; head = N_A. Size stays 3.
Map boxes align with nodes for readability; the map has no recency order.
